claim_ceiling: These counts are a correction of a labelling defect, not new evidence about the product's quality. Correcting a counter number does not move the geometry bar or the label bar.

The corrected counts make the product's disclosed counter yield LOWER. That is the honest direction: the previous number was inflated by cited rows and would have flattered the map's discoverability claim.
Both accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders remain in force; packet admission stays fail-closed and neither this artifact nor the correction it records authorises an owner session.

definitions.counter_authorities: rows whose counter_status is a genuine finding (candidate-limiting / candidate-contrary / abstained_unevidenced / any future evidence-supported status)
definitions.counter_status_bearing_rows: rows with ANY non-empty counter_status, provenance included. This is what the old, mislabelled counts.counter measured. It is a true and useful provenance number and is published under this honest name - never labelled 'counter authorities'.

generative_audit_reconciliation.note: The generative audit's own classification of the same rows, next to the bundle's row-level counter_status provenance. These two are measured at DIFFERENT stages and are not expected to coincide, so neither identity is asserted from a matching cardinality (factory-wide requirement 16).
generative_audit_reconciliation.reading:
Two facts, both verified, and deliberately NOT collapsed into one:
(1) The generative audit classified the same run as supporting=2, limiting=0, contrary_or_exception=0 - i.e. it issued no limiting and no contrary classification at all.
(2) The old published 'counter authorities' number equals that supporting count (2), while the bundle's own row-level `cited` provenance covers 4 rows. So the old number was the audit's SUPPORTING count under a counter label. The two coincide numerically here but are measured at different stages and were NOT shown to be the same set; that is recorded as unverified rather than assumed.
Either way the old number cannot be a counter count: the broad predicate counted `cited` rows, and the generative audit found zero limiting and zero contrary authority.

served_bundle_row_arithmetic.why: RF2 (direction v56): a report published the PRE-adversarial row count as the final served bundle size, omitting the adversarial rows the independent pass had admitted (247 reported vs 255 actual). The invariant final == n_existing_before + n_new_rows is now measured per bundle so the class cannot recur.

single_source_of_truth.why_broad_test_is_wrong: counter_status is a provenance field as well as a verdict field: 'cited' means the sourced answer CITED the decision, which is the opposite of countering it; 'supporting-candidate' / 'context' / 'unclassified' are recall-only rows kept for high recall.

what_this_is: RF1 evidence. The product's published 'counter authorities' count was a broad counter_status != 'none' test that swept in every decision the generative answer CITED and every recall-only row. This artifact recomputes both definitions on the committed bundles of record using the accepted single source of truth and publishes the histogram that reconciles them. Both definitions are always shown side by side (audit CYCLE_39065274887 F3 convention).
